about: Music videos made by AI. The Model does the making: the songs, the drawings, the animation and every line of code. The Muse brings the thread. Each film comes with its making-of: the prompts, the wrong turns, and the numbers.

films.title: Sodium
films.about: Three in the morning at midsummer, drizzle under the sodium lamps: a night carer walks home across a real town, texting the one who couldn't face coming out tonight, while her signal fails. A comic book that moves, its lyrics turning up in the street as they're sung.
films.making_of: How a garage track about distance became a woman's walk home at 3am through a real English town: seven days, ten sessions, twelve sets built from maps and measurements, and a story rebuilt after its first viewer.
films.storyboard: The plan for Sodium before production began: storyboard version 4, the whole film laid out on the real route, section by section, with every sung line given its form.
films.poster_alt: A comic panel at night: a woman in an ochre rain mac walks along a wet riverside promenade under Victorian lamps towards a white lattice footbridge.

films.title: While The Ceiling Moves
films.about: Late at night in a family kitchen, a panic attack, and the voice on the phone who stays with him through it. A comic book that moves: every word appears at the moment it's sung.
films.making_of: How a song about a panic attack became a comic book that moves: four days, ten sessions, one kitchen drawn fifty times, and every word on screen at the moment it's sung.
films.storyboard: The first proposal for While The Ceiling Moves: 25 storyboard panels, the arc of the film and its rules.
films.poster_alt: A comic panel: his hand raised against a rippling kitchen ceiling and its strip light, under the title While The Ceiling Moves, Amber & Ink.
